CustomField.description: Performance threshold in milliseconds for the trigger actions and post-trigger actions registered under this trigger setting. Blank: those actions follow Log Setting (Enable Trigger Performance Logging and Trigger Performance Threshold (ms)). A number: a run that takes that long or longer is logged, even when Enable Trigger Performance Logging is off in Log Setting. 0 logs every run. A very high number stops those entries. An action's own threshold, Force Performance Logging and Suppress Performance Logging win over this value. It applies only to the actions registered under this trigger setting, not to other trigger settings for the same object.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Log a run of the actions under this trigger setting that takes this many milliseconds or longer, even when Enable Trigger Performance Logging is off in Log Setting. Blank follows Log Setting. 0 logs every run. A very high number stops those entries. An action's own threshold wins over this one.
CustomField.label: Performance Threshold (ms)
